_comment_root: launch-strictdoc server configuration. The launcher has no menu; edit this file directly. See README for path placeholder syntax.
_comment_overview: All fields optional. project_path = the default offered at the prompt and the last-used project (auto-saved after each run); the actual folder is normally chosen by dragging it onto launch-strictdoc.bat. Defaults: host (127.0.0.1); port (5111 = START port for auto-assignment); open_browser (true); output_path (empty=strictdoc default).
_comment_project_path: Optional. Default folder offered at the prompt and last-used project (auto-saved after each run, FR-1155). The actual folder is normally chosen by dragging it onto launch-strictdoc.bat (a file uses its parent folder). Path placeholders (replaced at first run / config init): USERNAME placeholder -> current Windows username; STARTER_ROOT placeholder -> the folder containing launch-strictdoc.bat. Bundled samples: samples/sd-basic-ja (the basics in .sdoc; copy this folder to start your own spec); samples/md-basic-ja (the same spec written entirely in .md); samples/sdoc-patterns (authoring patterns; 00-hello.sdoc is the minimal document to copy); samples/sovd-automotive-ja (Japanese SOVD spec, current default); samples/sovd-automotive-en (English SOVD spec).
_comment_host: Server bind host. Allowed: IPv4 dotted-decimal (e.g. 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0), 'localhost', or IPv6 literal (e.g. ::, ::1). 127.0.0.1 = local only (recommended). 0.0.0.0 and :: = LAN exposed (browser open auto-translates to 127.0.0.1).
_comment_port: Server START port (1024..65535). Default 5111 = strictdoc default. Multiple documents opened at once auto-get the next free port (5112, 5113, ... up to start+20) -- no need to change this (FR-1156).
_comment_open_browser: Auto-open default browser to http://host:port/ after Start succeeds. true|false.
_comment_output_path: strictdoc --output-path. Leave empty to use strictdoc default (project/output). Same path placeholders as project_path (USERNAME, STARTER_ROOT) supported.
